hooks.description: Block dangerous shell commands that could damage the project or hardware

hooks.prompt: Review this file change for Zephyr knowledge accuracy. Context: $ARGUMENTS. If the file is NOT a Zephyr reference file (.md in a skills directory), respond {"ok": true} immediately. For Zephyr reference files, check: 1) API signatures match current Zephyr v3.x documentation. 2) Devicetree examples use proper syntax (node-name@unit-address format). 3) Kconfig symbols follow CONFIG_ prefix convention. 4) No deprecated APIs referenced without migration notes. Respond {"ok": true} if accurate, or {"ok": false, "reason": "specific inaccuracy"}.

Verify knowledge content quality before stopping. Context: $ARGUMENTS. Check: 1) Any new or modified reference files contain substantive content (not stubs). 2) Code examples in reference files compile conceptually (correct Zephyr API usage). 3) No TODO/FIXME markers left in reference content. Respond {"ok": true} if complete, or {"ok": false, "reason": "specific issue"}.
